footprints.source: Original GND collision grid bit0, real scenario actor/point seeds, original rendered overview JPEG.
footprints.maskPolicy: Select four-connected nonblocked regions containing scenario actor/point seeds, omit border-connected outside, fill enclosed holes, expand180 native screen pixels for boundary scenery. Geographic footprint is derived from native collision; scenery fringe is an explicit display margin.

questRequirements.sourceImage: ep1 quests/Mischief Society - Articles - Errand for Gedo_files/gedo.jpg
questRequirements.evidence: The prose explicitly requires experience level at least 16 and says the mission can be done any time after reaching level 16.

steps.role: Quest giver and Crimson Dagger recipient

questRequirements.scenarioEvidence: Scenario.Mct NPC placement records identify Gedo in 01000000 and Malse in 00000000. These scenario IDs are exact NPC locations; the numeric requirement applies to the quest, not entry to either town.

levelPolicy: The local guide provides no numeric area-level ranges. Sort follows guide episode/region progression; no numeric recommended or monster levels are invented.
geographyPolicy: Relative zone placement follows printed guide anchors. Episode spacing and terrain illustration sizes are a navigational composition, not continuous game coordinates.
